issue_context.title: Support for pylint format
issue_context.body:
I like that ruff, for the most part, is drop-in replacement for flake8. In terms of local development, I have found this to be true and usability is fantastic.

The problem I've run into is that, it lacks support for `pylint` format, one of the two formatters included in flake8:
https://flake8.pycqa.org/en/latest/internal/formatters.html

We use Jenkins for CI and a lot of useful mappings for pylint format are missing for the standard PEP8 text format.

---

Anyone else in the same boat? Is this worthwhile to build?

Also, is it in line with what this project is trying to do?
comments:
Thanks for the kind words, it means a lot, truly!

I haven't used Pylint format before so bear with me as I confirm: the requirement here is just that we tweak the output message format, right? (E.g., today we support `ruff /path/to/file.py --format junit` to output XML; so the request here is to support `--format pylint`, and use the format specified in the Flake8 docs?)

If so: we can definitely support that, and it should be very easy to do.

That's exactly what I am requesting!

I can try to fork and play around with this first.
For the most part, what you want is in `printer.rs`. We'd want to add a new case there for `SerializationFormat::Pylint` (and to the enum itself in `src/settings/types.rs`).

review_comments: Tweaked this to put some of the plain-text characters in the format string directly.
I was unsure about this but this is more what I would expect.
